title: Sort each item into its source family
instructions: For each item, decide which family of historical source it belongs to: ARCHAEOLOGICAL (a physical object dug up), LITERARY (a written text or inscription) or ORAL (something spoken or sung, passed down across generations).

bins.name: Archaeological
bins.description: Physical objects: pottery, tools, coins, ruins, bones, seeds, charcoal.

bins.name: Literary
bins.description: Written texts and inscriptions: Vedas, epics, religious texts, royal edicts.

bins.name: Oral
bins.description: Songs, stories, genealogies and traditions passed down by word of mouth.
